paragraphs: Friend, this one is heavy, and I'm not going to pretend otherwise. The fifth and sixth trumpets bring torment and death on the earth (Revelation 9:5, 15). But look at who gets harmed by the locusts: only "those who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads" (Revelation 9:4). Even in the middle of all this smoke, God's people are marked as His, and that mark matters.

Now here's the part that stops me cold. After all of that, "the rest of mankind who were not killed by these plagues still did not repent of the works of their hands" (Revelation 9:20). They kept worshiping idols that "cannot see or hear or walk" (Revelation 9:20), and they did not repent of their murder, sorcery, sexual immorality and theft (Revelation 9:21). I think the lesson is that a hard heart can see the warning and still not turn. Friend, that's a quiet thing to look at in the mirror, so ask yourself what you're holding onto that can't hold you back.

So here's what I take with me to the ovens. God warns, God marks His own, and God keeps calling people to turn back to Him. I'd rather turn today than find out how long I could stay stubborn, and I've got a drawer's worth of years to tell you stubborn gets you nowhere. This story is NOT done, so keep your apron on and keep your ovens ready.
